{{samename|volumes published in English by VIZ Media|List of Pokémon Sword & Shield volumes}}
The {{MangaArc|Sword & Shield}} of Pokémon Adventures is being separately collected into mini-volumes by [[Shogakukan]] in Japan. The volume releases began on June 26, 2020, and later ended on July 28, 2023. Once the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} ends in the regular volumes, the ''Sword & Shield'' arc will be properly collected in that format as well.
